column1: # Dutch glossary. CLAUDE-ONLY PROPOSAL (2026-11-05): drafted by one model, pending the three-vendor debate; nothing here is final.

# Term column: approved Dutch forms, separated by " | "; the first is the canonical one. Definitions carry D3's meanings (scratch/english-fixes/d3-*). Definition text is English on purpose: it describes the en.tsv term.

# Rows D3 retires keep the chosen term's Dutch until en.tsv drops them. D3's new rows (and renamed ids) wait in l10n/pending/glossary-d3/nl.tsv until D3 merges, because the loader refuses an id en.tsv lacks.

# HOLD until D3 merges: en.tsv and the strings still use Top speed and Maximum speed in their old senses, while the top-speed and maximum-speed rows below already use D3's. Following those rows now would call the setting Topsnelheid and the measured value Maximumsnelheid, the swap style guide 7 forbids.

# So do not draft or merge these keys before D3: dashboard_model_tile_top_speed, controls_experimental_speed_limit, the readings_maximum_speed_kmh ladder (with _short and _compact), and main_speed_* if they arrive first. They stay English (council verdict fallback). pack.py has no per-key filter, so a run over those areas must rule them out by hand. Other keys with these terms already match D3.
# Evidence and reasons are in l10n/style/nl.md.
